Ivy (CSM): Heads-up: Novatek (acct: nov-88) trial day 11, only sandbox token tested once. health dipped to 49. low activation flag :warning:
RevBot: Alert: inactivity + trial_near_end triggered. health 82 -> 49. rule fired at 5976543210.
Ivy (CSM): Proposing a 'one-touch save' play: 30m pairing focused on first inference + embeddings, $225 starter credit, and a 3-question feedback form. goal = first 3 successful calls in-session.
Marco (AM): +1. If they still can't onboard, what's the downgrade safety path? Need clear customer-facing language.
Ivy (CSM): Draft downgrade path: 1) 30-day trial pause (no billing) 2) Option to migrate to Starter tier (reduced quota) for first paid cycle at -15% 3) Offer office-hours week. We'll provide acceptance link.
Rita (Enablement): I can run the 30m session. Agenda: 5m goals, 15m live run, 8m fixes, 2m next steps. I'll prepare a tiny repo and 90s async clip fallback.
Omar (Support): I'll open ticket SUP-9938 and attach logs. please confirm they use staging keys during pairing.
Leo (CS Ops): Approving $225 credit. file CSOPS ticket after session with notes and link to SUP-9938.
Novatek: Quick Q: can we do async first? our infra team is in meetings today.
Ivy (CSM): Sure fallback = async clip + $125 credit. But live pairing preferred for fastest outcome.
Rita (Enablement): snippet I'll share in workshop: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING" -d '{"model":"embed-mini","input":"hi"}'```
Omar (Support): SUP-9938 created and assigned to eng-oncall. adding SDK check and sample error paste.
Marco (AM): KPI: health >= 68 and 3 calls within 5 days. If unmet, escalate to AM review and offer downgrade path.
Ivy (CSM): Action owners: Ivy = outreach + feedback form; Rita = run session + async clip; Omar = SUP-9938; Leo = credit ticket; Marco = escalation. I'll send invite now. Will paste verbatim feedback here after session. Closing loop for now :white_check_mark:
